author: K_R_Cord
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age?
25

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)
K_R_Cord#1863

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?
2-4 days a week while being able to reply on Discord every day.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?
I am someone who likes to push the boundaries of XML. I am a believer that Atlas as a plugin is the ultimate plugin to make a gamemode server. Really it is the XML portion. With that, I believe I can make anything I want and know how to make it.

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?
Making a terrible map. Map building is all trial and error with using prior knowledge in what you failed in and what you did well in to make your next map. If someone keeps making great maps, their skills are completely limited in experimenting with which makes the maps stale. 

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
Besides hill and leakable objectives, I know pretty much all of the documented xml in the docs. Also, know a few undocumented features of XML.

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
XML, could build maps but strictly XML would allow me to work on concepts easier
Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
https://maps.avicus.net/atlas/MapTesting/XML%20Assessment/K_R_Cord%20-%20Return%20of%20the%20Jedi/ (Cords were broken because I had wrong information.
https://maps.avicus.net/atlas/TDM/Frenzy/DragonWars/
https://maps.avicus.net/atlas/CTW/EnderHill/ Even though I am not an author on this map, I gave the initial idea of Ender-CTW and the concept of crafting the wools. PieZ can confirm this for me.
Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
I am in the middle of developing Arms Race (CSGO game mode) with just XML and also an air PVP arena that I have finished but I do need a texture pack to complete it so I am getting that finished. 

Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?
I believe that Map Developer is the most important rank on this server. Yes, developers and admins keep this server afloat, but map devs control where the server goes. I have hopefully proved that I can lead a team and even though I do admit here I am working for the Map Developer rank, I do not mind sitting as a Builder and helping both teams out when needed. It would probably be better for me to be in this position.  So in short, I believe my leadership skills, plus the fact I can easily guide a server into getting an ideal situation where the server looks good for new players and appeal to older players.
How do you think you will help the map development team?
I am able to expand on new sub-gamemode ideas and also direct this server. I could do community interaction well but I would need to rebuild myself for obvious reasons. I am willing to go the extra mile for this server and do what I have to do.

Thanks!
- The Head MapDevs
